resources.string: Lets the app buttons on the remote (Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, TCL Channel) open the apps you picked in {app}, from any app. It only reads those buttons.

{app}\'s {catalog} helper: notes the titles you open in the catalog\'s TV app for the home screen\'s Continue watching, and opens a title you pick on the home screen (it presses Search and types it). It only sees that app\'s screens.
